method: Separate matched physical framebuffer comparison: actual native2x versus raw WebDPR2 at identical PNG dimensions. Existing comparator at physical scale1, same RGB1 flat-interior tolerance and seam thresholds. No resampling, alignment or new tolerance.
limits: Does not replace native1x report or grant independent visual approval. Physical sample counts are a separate condition set. Adjacent unsynchronized particles and blink state are not globally accepted.
